question_text: A 36-year-old man is brought in by ambulance after being found down on the sidewalk. It is uncertain how long he was down before being found, and he did not have any forms of identification when he was found. On presentation, the man is found to still be unconscious with a disheveled and unkempt appearance. He is also found to be taking slow, shallow breaths that smell of alcohol. His temperature is 98.8°F (37.1°C), blood pressure is 106/67 mmHg, pulse is 119/min, respirations are 5/min, and oxygen saturation is 87% on room air. His pupils are found to be fixed and contracted, and he has multiple bruises and scars on his body. Which of the following sets of findings would most likely be seen in this patient?
